profile.headline: Software Engineer at Alltegrio
profile.summary:
I identify myself as a great strategist and a lover of my work, I understand identifying problems or needs in the market, sketching out the project, planning its development and carrying out all the necessary tests until it works without errors. 
I have developed a strategist and developer thinking focusing on ways to digitize and automate tasks and processes, finding and taking advantage of opportunities, in order to meet needs in Alltegrio with greater precision.

positions.description: • Built a backend gateway microservice to connect to external payment partners, using TypeScript, NestJS, and TypeORM.

projects.title: Everyday Luck App 天天吉
projects.description:

- App: https://github.com/bonham000/everyday-luck-app
- Backend: https://github.com/bonham000/dragon

projects.title: Ticketz
projects.description:
Open-source work-order system for IT, maintenance, and contractors developed for an Arizona school system:
- Developed application components to handle new ticket submission using React and React-Router.
- Implemented client-side form validation using JavaScript to reduce server traffic and improve user experience.
- Engineered backend API endpoints and database schemas to handle new organizations, users, and tickets.
- Improved frontend responsive UI and navigation sidebar animation using bootstrap and custom CSS.
